bibl.title: Zuckers Korrespondenz zu seiner Grabung in Narmouthis (Madīnat Māḍī )
bibl.seg: Holger Essler, Zuckers Korrespondenz zu seiner Grabung in Narmouthis (Madīnat Māḍī).
bibl.note: Edition of documents and letters related to the excavation at Narmouthis (Medinet Madi) directed by Friedrich Zucker in 1910. Authors and addressees are L. Borchardt, E. Chassinat, F. Zucker.
